role: Public contract of the C chunk mesher: the probe-directory formats (table.bin, atlas.json, chunks.bin, tileentities.bin, manifest.json), the mesher, tessellator and world structs, and the load, mesh and world-accessor functions render_blocks.c defines.

structs.name: rb_props
structs.java: per-block render properties from table.bin (canBlockGrass, renderAsNormalBlock, useNeighborBrightness, getRenderBlockPass, isOpaqueCube, slab, light, getAmbientOcclusionLightValue)

structs.name: rb_band
structs.java: none: the device mesher's band table entry (cuda/meshing): a band of a chunk section and whether its chunk and mask hold it, where ChunkCache's getBlock, getBlockMetadata and getSavedLightValue chain ends

structs.name: rb_mesher
structs.java: RenderBlocks instance fields plus BlockAnvil.field_149833_b and BlockPistonBase stored bounds

gpu: struct rb_table, rb_atlas, rb_world, rb_tess: heap pointers (icon_name, props, bounds, data, te, raw) rather than fixed-capacity inline arrays; allocated once at load, not per frame
struct rb_mesher: holds pointers to table, atlas, world and tessellator (a small pointer graph a GPU port would flatten into indices)
notes: Header only; definitions are in render_blocks.c. The render types it lists as ported (0, 1, 4, 31, 40) are out of date: render_blocks2.c and render_blocks3.c now cover every type RenderBlocks dispatches except 36 (renderBlockRedstoneDiode: BlockRedstoneDiode returns 36 but both concrete diodes override it to 15 and 37, so no 1.7.10 block reaches it; the native dispatch prints a not-ported notice for it). Type 22 (chest) draws nothing in RenderBlocks and nothing natively. rb_mesher's special, special2 and special3 are pointers into one block rb_mesher_init allocates (read-only after init, so a device lane's copy of the mesher is 576 bytes, not 1464: lane/meshkern). rb_world's bands and band_s0 are the device mesher's band table (NULL on the host; render_blocks.c band_of under __NVPTX__).
